title: ClientError::Parse and ::Serialize wrap same type, only Serialize has #[from]
description: Two variants (Parse and Serialize) both wrap serde_json::Error. Only Serialize carries #[from], so ? on any serde_json operation auto-converts to Serialize. A contributor adding JSON deserialization code who uses ? instead of .map_err(ClientError::Parse) will silently produce the wrong variant. The comment warns about this but it is easy to miss. Maintenance consequence: incorrect error variants in the wild produce misleading error messages and break callers who match on Parse vs Serialize.
